description: A crowned bone face, two sizes too big for the starved body carrying it. Fights head-first. Goes to ash.
lore: It does not walk. It gathers both feet under itself and crosses the ground in bounds, and it takes you crown-first, head down, the hardest thing left on it leading. Nothing that ever hunted for a living fights with its face. And it hurries. Everything empty in the open country has all the time there is; this one moves like something with an errand, and the errand is not its own.

What comes off one is mostly not its own either. Grey talons of the kind the lit thing sheds. Hooks sized for a big cat's mouth. On [[characters/646b922c|Sigrun]]'s bench last autumn, out of a head with two red eyes, a whole wet eye, brown. [[characters/54bead23|Osric]], new enough to still ask things out loud, asked what it wanted the eye for. Sigrun tied the bag and put it with the others. Everyone in the room understood the answer except him.

Broken, it folds at the knees and settles, and the settling is ash; the wind has the heap by morning, near [[lore/the_hole_under_the_mountain|the mouth]] as anywhere. It leaves no mask. The face goes with the rest of it — it only goes last.
gm_notes: The borrowed parts are this leaf's puzzle piece: the emptying collects. The correction — that its true bottom is not-being-seen — belongs to matte_black_shadow_stone and must not migrate back here; the pair splits charge/stealth.
